gloss: to be divided, to branch off, to split into

definitions.gloss: to be divided, to split into, to branch off
definitions.explanation: For something to separate into two or more parts. Used for roads branching, groups splitting, opinions diverging, etc.

definitions.gloss: to be classified into, to fall into categories
definitions.explanation: To be divided into distinct categories or types.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}が{二|ふた}つに{分|わ}かれている。
{意見|いけん}が{賛成|さんせい}と{反対|はんたい}に{分|わ}かれた。
examples.english: Opinions were divided between for and against.

examples.japanese: この{川|かわ}は{下流|かりゅう}で{三|みっ}つに{分|わ}かれている。
examples.english: This river branches into three downstream.

examples.japanese: {動物|どうぶつ}はいくつかのグループに{分|わ}かれる。
examples.english: Animals are classified into several groups.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}の{動詞|どうし}は{五段|ごだん}と{一段|いちだん}に{分|わ}かれます。
examples.english: Japanese verbs are divided into godan and ichidan types.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {分|わ}ける (transitive, to divide/separate). Pattern: Xが（Yに）{分|わ}かれる.

ASPECT (ている):
{分|わ}かれている indicates a resulting state: "is divided/split."

KANJI NOTE:
{分|わ}かれる and {別|わか}れる are both read わかれる but differ in meaning. {分|わ}かれる means "to split/divide" (one thing becomes multiple), while {別|わか}れる means "to part/say goodbye" (people separate from each other).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{道|みち}が{分|わ}かれる (a road forks)
・{意見|いけん}が{分|わ}かれる (opinions are divided)
・AとBに{分|わ}かれる (to split into A and B)
